lines.l: I'm feeling in the air, the summer's out of reach
Empty lake, empty streets, the sun burns down alone
I'm driving by your house, though I know you're not home
I can see you, your breath can shine in the sun
You get your hair pulled back in the sunglasses, oh baby
I can tell you that love for you will still be strong
After the poison, summer have gone
I never will forget those nights
I wonder if it was a dream
Remember how you made me crazy
Remember how I made you scream
That I don't understand what happened to our love
But baby, when I get you back
I'm gonna show you what I made of
I can see you
Your blood skin shining in the sun
I see you walking real slow
Smiling at everyone
I can tell you my love for you will still be strong
After the poison, summer of God
We'll be right back.
Out on the road today, I saw a black flag sticker on a Cadillac
A little voice inside my hands that don't look back
You can never look back
I thought I knew what love was, what did I know?
If those days are gone forever, I should just let them go
But I can see you, your birds keep shining your sun
You've got to topple down with the radio on, baby
Now I can tell you that love for you will still be strong
After the voice of the summer has gone
I can see you, your bloods can shine your sun
You've got to hit slick back in this way there is all, baby
I can tell you that love for you will still be strong after boys are inside my head gone.
Marcin Werywał.
